title: Shifting Archive
summary: A dynamic level where a director agent rearranges archive rooms while preserving a fair path to the objective.

objective.win: Find the index card containing the archive key and submit its code.
objective.loss: Reach twenty turns without submitting the correct code.

rules: The director may rearrange exits after each turn.
At least one path to the index card must remain reachable.
The director must provide a visible hint after every third player action.
The win and loss conditions do not change during play.

director.agent_role: Maintain a surprising but fair archive layout during play.
forbidden_actions: hide all paths to the index card
give different rules to human and agent players
fairness_constraints: A valid path to the objective must exist after every director action.
Every director action must be logged.
Hints must be based on current reachable state.

acceptance_criteria: The director contract limits dynamic changes.
The level remains playable by humans and agents.
The event log can be reviewed after a run.
